implementation_notes: Ruby is the language where KISS is easiest: `Struct`/`Data.define` for values, plain methods over factories, `Enumerable` for loops, and the standard library (`json`, `csv`, `securerandom`, `digest`) before gems. Reach for ActiveRecord/Rails only when the whole stack, not one feature, is warranted.
pitfalls: Metaprogramming to remove a few lines
A gem that solves a problem the standard library already solves
Mixins used as a substitute for naming things
